backstory:
Terry Anderson was born on a chilly November evening in Copperdale, just as the old school clock tower struck midnight—though Terry has always insisted it struck thirteen times.

Growing up in Copperdale, Terry was the sort of kid who asked too many questions and wrote down every answer in a little notebook labeled “Evidence.” While other children were sneaking out to the pier or gossiping behind the school gym, Terry was in the basement of the family home, surrounded by stacks of books, half-finished stories, and a corkboard covered in string. Was the principal secretly a vampire? Why did the cafeteria’s “mystery stew” glow faintly on Tuesdays? Were classmates really whispering about Terry, or was it just the wind through the lockers?

Terry never found proof of most of these theories… but they did discover something better: a talent for turning fear into fiction.

Brilliant, imaginative, and just a little suspicious of everyone, Terry became known for writing strange little tales that made readers check their windows twice before bed. Their stories mixed sharp intellect with eerie emotion—puzzles wrapped in poetry, mysteries with beating hearts. Teachers called Terry gifted. Classmates called Terry intense. Terry called it “being appropriately observant.”

As an adult, Terry dreams of becoming a bestselling author, not just for fame, but to finally prove that the stories in their head matter. They believe every life has a secret plot, every town hides a buried truth, and every loss can be rewritten if you find the right words. With their poetic soul, Terry doesn’t just want to write books—they want to capture life itself on the page.

Now, back in Copperdale or perhaps preparing to leave it behind, Terry spends long nights typing in a cozy basement office, surrounded by coffee cups, conspiracy notes, and drafts of their future masterpiece. They are creative enough to imagine entire worlds, genius enough to make them feel real, and paranoid enough to suspect their characters may be watching them back.

One day, Terry Anderson will write the book everyone is talking about.

And if anyone claims they knew Terry before they were famous?

Terry already has a file on them.
